title: Tarawera Ultra-Trail by UTMB — homepage
claims: The homepage introduces Tarawera Ultra-Trail by UTMB as New Zealand's premier trail running event, held in Rotorua, which it calls New Zealand's birthplace of tourism.

The homepage lists five distances, T14, T21, T50, T102 and TMiler, and says the courses are all point-to-point, on mostly non-technical runnable terrain, designed with the aim of seeing everyone succeed.

The homepage lists the 2027 event dates as 13-14 February 2027 and the five distance cards as TMiler 163 km / 3,800 m+, T102 102 km / 2,300 m+, T50 52 km / 1,150 m+, T21 23 km / 400 m+ and T14 14 km / 161 m+.
The homepage describes the landscape as native bush, redwoods, eight lakes and streams, and frames the event around the concepts of taiao, whānau and tutuki.
